title: Angel Falls and the world's tallest waterfalls
examples: What is the tallest waterfall in the world?
Which is bigger, Niagara or Victoria Falls?

explain.say: Imagine standing at the top of a cliff so high that the falling water turns into mist before it reaches the ground. That is Angel Falls! Look at the bars on the board: each is a waterfall's height.

explain.say: See the first bar? Angel Falls in Venezuela drops 979 metres, the tallest waterfall on Earth. The Pemón people who live nearby call it Kerepakupai Merú. Can you find the tall building on the board?

items.label: Victoria Falls
items.ask: Why is Victoria Falls called the smoke that thunders?

explain.say: That is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest building, 828 metres. Look: Angel Falls is even taller! Next to it is Tugela Falls in South Africa, almost as high.

items.ask: Why is Victoria Falls called the smoke that thunders?

explain.say: Now look at the short bars: Victoria Falls, Iguazu and Niagara. They are not tall, but they are wide and roar with huge amounts of water. Which do you think is the shortest?

items.ask: Why is Victoria Falls called the smoke that thunders?

explain.say: Yes, Niagara, only about 51 metres, yet so powerful! Well done. Wow fact: Victoria Falls is more than 1.7 kilometres wide, making the largest sheet of falling water on Earth.

items.label: Victoria Falls
items.ask: Why is Victoria Falls called the smoke that thunders?

faq.a: Angel Falls in Venezuela is about 979 metres tall, with a single unbroken drop of about 807 metres. It is the tallest waterfall in the world.

faq.q: Why is it called Angel Falls?
faq.a: It was named after Jimmie Angel, an American pilot who flew over it in the 1930s. The local Pemón people had long known it as Kerepakupai Merú.
asks: Who is Angel Falls named after?

faq.q: Why is Victoria Falls called the smoke that thunders?
faq.a: Its local name, Mosi-oa-Tunya, means the smoke that thunders. The spray rises like smoke and the roar can be heard far away. It lies between Zambia and Zimbabwe.

faq.q: Which is bigger, Niagara or Victoria Falls?
faq.a: Victoria Falls is both taller, about 108 metres, and wider, about 1.7 kilometres. Niagara is about 51 metres tall but carries a lot of water.
Iguazu Falls is on the border of Argentina and Brazil. It is a chain of about 275 separate waterfalls.
asks: How many waterfalls are at Iguazu?

facts: Angel Falls in Venezuela is about 979 metres tall, the world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall.
Victoria Falls, on the Zambia–Zimbabwe border, is about 1,708 metres wide and 108 metres tall.
